user.title: Noxcast
user.description: Choose the weather source and, optionally, battery sensors used to detect curtailment. Add your PV arrays afterwards.

data_description.weather_entity: Must provide hourly irradiance (e.g. DWD sun_irradiance).
data_description.soc_sensors: Hours with a full battery are excluded from learning, because output may be curtailed.
data_description.soc_full_pct: State of charge from which curtailment is assumed.

error.no_irradiance: This weather entity provides no irradiance in its hourly forecast.
error.weather_unavailable: The weather entity did not return a forecast.
error.soc_unit: Battery sensors must report their state of charge in %.

abort.already_configured: Noxcast is already set up. Add PV arrays to the existing entry.

user.title: PV array
user.description: Modules with the same orientation. Power sensors are summed (e.g. two MPPT inputs).

data_description.azimuth: Compass direction the modules face: 90° east, 180° south, 270° west.
data_description.valid_since: Ignore older history, e.g. after moving or re-orienting the modules.
data_description.temp_coeff: Pmax temperature coefficient from the module datasheet, e.g. -0.26. Recommended. Empty = typical value (-0.35); learned only with the satellite filter.
Pmax temperature coefficient from the module datasheet, e.g. -0.26. Recommended. Empty = typical value (-0.35); learned only with the satellite filter.

error.sensor_required: Select at least one power sensor.
error.sensor_missing: A selected sensor does not exist.
error.sensor_unit: Power sensors must report W or kW.
error.sensor_state_class: Power sensors need state_class 'measurement' so Home Assistant keeps long-term statistics.
error.date_in_future: The date must not be in the future.

exclude_period.name: Exclude period from learning
exclude_period.description: Ignore a period in which output was curtailed, e.g. holidays with zero export.

relearn.name: Relearn
relearn.description: Learn efficiency and shading again from history now.

init.title: Learning sources
init.description: Weather archives used when learning from history. Open-Meteo is the default and needs no key.

data_description.archive_temperature: Needed to learn the temperature loss. Without it, efficiency absorbs the average temperature.
data_description.satellite: Uses satellite irradiance to select clear hours for learning. Optional; quality varies by region.
data_description.api_key: Only for commercial or self-hosted access.

error.archive_failed: The archive could not be reached or returned an error.
